text:
Maya: dropped a new frame for the min/max + peak-topup flow: https://figma.link/peak-topup-v2 — focus: clearer labels, inline cost, and guardrail hints. can folks glance for copy + a11y? Jun: quick read: overall layout good. microcopy idea: instead of 'min'/'max' try 'Min reserved' and 'Max burstable'. keeps 'reserved' language explicit. Priya: UX nit: the compact row hides numeric values at small widths. we should show condensed numbers (e.g., '2 ▸ 8') when space is tight. also keyboard focus should reveal full values. Leo: accessibility: need aria-describedby linking the stepper to the SLO slider so screen readers understand relation. also add role="status" for cost updates. Carlos: billing clarity: users keep asking how "top-up" is charged. suggest small inline link "how top-ups billed" opens a tiny modal with one-line math and example. Maya: copy proposal: primary labels: 'Guaranteed' / 'Max capacity' with small muted hint under Max: 'Can scale up for peaks'. topup CTA: 'Top up for peaks' (short). Jun: probing: do we need two topup flavors? ephemeral vs sustained. customers might want 'short peak' vs 'extended peak' — could complicate UI though. maybe hide advanced options behind "Advanced". Priya: keyboard behavior: when pressing arrow keys on stepper, announce new estimate in polite live region and focus should not jump to cost modal. also provide visible focus ring and value tooltip on hover/focus. Leo: contrast check: the topup pill background + white text fails on dark chrome. propose darker teal (#006f67) or switch to outline + filled focus ring. Carlos: backend constraints: top-ups are rounded to nearest GPU-minute. UI should show approximated billing unit: "Billed per GPU-minute". UX should avoid showing precise cents for <1min intervals. Maya: validation UX: if user sets Guaranteed > Max, show inline helper: "Guaranteed cannot exceed Max capacity" and two CTAs: 'Swap values' and 'Set Max to X'. make the helper tone helpful not alarmist. Jun: ARIA sample for stepper + live update: ``` 2 GPUs
Estimated cost: $0.95 / hr
``` Priya: minor copy tweak: avoid parentheses-heavy labels. instead of 'Max (burstable)' use 'Max capacity — burstable'. it's easier for screen readers. Leo: also add aria-hidden="true" for decorative icons and provide textual alt via aria-label on actionable elements. Carlos: edge-case: multi-pool deployments — if user picks GPU pool A in region X, topup availability may differ. UI should gray out topup CTA and show tooltip: 'Top-ups unavailable for selected pool'. Maya: good catch. we'll show availability badge per pool in pool-picker. also we'll surface plan limits: if account doesn't allow sustained topups, show CTA disabled with 'Upgrade to enable sustained top-ups'. DesignBot: added checklist: visible numeric values on narrow screens, aria-describedby relations, role=status for cost, debounce live updates (250ms), contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for CTAs, accessible error helper with 'Swap values' action focusable, pool availability state and tooltip length < 140 chars. Jun: acceptance criteria suggestion: keyboard only flow can set min/max and invoke 'Top up' within 6 tab presses from container start. we should test that. Priya: i'll prototype condensed numeric reveal + focus tooltip. Leo: i'll run the WCAG contrast tests and provide exact hex pair options. Carlos: i'll add the billing copy to the modal and a small API flag: topup_billing_hint: 'gpu_minute'. Maya: plan: I'll update figma with the wording changes (Guaranteed / Max capacity), add the pool availability badge, wire the helper CTA for swap, and add the aria attributes. aiming to upload by EOD. objections? Jun: none. looks solid. Priya: +1. Leo: i'll follow up with contrast swatches. Carlos: will coordinate on API flag and docs. Maya: thanks team — i'll ping when the new frame is live. :rocket:
